description:
Position: Software Engineer - FullStack
 
 Location: Provo - UT
 
 Type: Full time 
 
 
 
 Technical Skills needs: 
1.Worked on Engineering projects which involved system integration via APIs
2. Deep Expertise on Javascript frameworks: AngularJS and NodeJS a must
3. Experience in MySQL or other SQL Databases
4. Experience in working in an agile environment and using tools like Jira
5. Experience with Docker and AWS dev ops tools a big advantage

 Core Functional Skills needed: 
1. Senior hands-on contributor in his previous organizations/project.
2. At least 2 years’ experience leading offshore or onsite teams.
3. Must have done extensive client interaction on projects
4. Extremely strong communication skills – would need to articulate his thoughts clearly
5. Must be able to create engineering requirements documentation, handling and running projects independently.

 In this role, you will: 
1. Leading the team and the engagement with the help of your previous experience and expertise.
2. Developing scalable, fast, robust, and simple web-based solutions to solve complex business problems
3. Working closely with your peers to gather and incorporate their feedback into your feature design
4. Obsessing over the performance of your new features and applying the same lessons to improve the performance of existing features
5. Attend daily stand-up meetings, prioritize features, and work with a sense of urgency to deliver value to your customers
6. Provide insights and recommendations that have tangible business impacts
7. Build relationships with clients to understand their business, and to enable them to make better decisions.


 This is a Full time Role


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
